source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 7: carnival wheel, diameter 40 ft, centre 28 ft, 120 s per turn; three unlabelled asks, labelled (a)-(c) as in the answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 7 (a) [not labelled in print; the answer key calls it (a)] A carnival ride consists of a vertical wheel with a diameter of 40 feet. The centre of the wheel is 28 feet above the ground. The wheel rotates at a constant speed and takes 120 seconds to make one complete revolution. Model an equation that describes the height \(h(t)\) of a rider on the wheel as a function of time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
Question 5 jaisa model hai, farq yeh ke yahan centre ki unchai seedhi di hui hai.
Plan: radius \(=\) diameter ka aadha; \(c = \frac{2\pi}{120}\); rider neeche se shuru.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: diameter 40 ft, centre zameen se 28 ft upar, ek chakkar 120 second mein.
Humein find karna hai: \(h(t)\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: \(h = \text{centre} - \text{radius} \times \cos(ct)\). Hum maante hain ke \(t = 0\) par rider sab se neeche hai (sawal nahi batata, key yahi leti hai). Is shuru ke point ki wajah se \(-\cos\) aata hai.

Radius (amplitude)
\[r = \tfrac{40}{2} = 20 \text{ ft}\]
Kyun: Diameter ka aadha radius hai; rider centre se 20 ft upar aur 20 ft neeche jata hai.

Centre (midline)
\[a = 28 \text{ ft}\]
Kyun: Yahan centre ki unchai seedhi di hui hai, Question 5 ki tarah nikalni nahi pari. Is se sab se neecha point \(28 - 20 = 8\) ft aur sab se ooncha \(28 + 20 = 48\) ft.

Angular speed
\[c = \dfrac{2\pi}{120} = \dfrac{\pi}{60}\]
Kyun: Ek chakkar (\(2\pi\) radian) 120 second mein. Period \(\frac{2\pi}{c} = 120\) se \(c = \frac{\pi}{60}\).

Model likhein
\[h(t) = 28 - 20\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{60}t\right)\]
Kyun: \(-\cos\) apni sab se chhoti value se shuru hota hai: \(h(0) = 28 - 20 = 8\) ft, yani pahiye ka sab se neecha point.

Tasdeeq
\[h(0) = 8,\; h(60) = 48,\; h(120) = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Shuru mein neeche, aadhe chakkar (60 s) par sab se upar, poore chakkar (120 s) par phir neeche. Model pahiye ki harkat se poori tarah milta hai.
Dhyan dein: Question 5 mein sab se neecha point diya tha aur centre nikala tha; yahan centre diya hai. Dono mein formula ki shakal ek hi hai: centre minus radius times cosine.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of h(t) = 28 minus 20 cos(pi t over 60) for t from 0 to 120 seconds. The curve starts at (0, 8), peaks at (60, 48) and passes (90, 28) on the centre line. A horizontal line h = 36 cuts the curve at t about 37.86 s and t about 82.14 s.

blocks.prompt: 7 (b) [not labelled in print] A carnival ride consists of a vertical wheel with a diameter of 40 feet. The centre of the wheel is 28 feet above the ground. The wheel rotates at a constant speed and takes 120 seconds to make one complete revolution. How high is the rider from the ground after 90 seconds?
blocks.explanation:
Model mein \(t = 90\) rakhna hai.
Plan: angle \(\frac{90\pi}{60} = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), jis ka cosine 0 hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 28 - 20\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{60}t\right)\), \(t = 90\).
Humein find karna hai: 90 second baad unchai \(h(90)\).
Tareeqa: Value rakh kar \(\cos\frac{3\pi}{2} = 0\) use karenge.

\(h\) nikalein
\[h(90) = 28 - 20\cos\tfrac{3\pi}{2}\]
\[= 28 - 20(0) = 28 \text{ ft}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 270^{\circ} = 0\), kyunke unit circle par \(270^{\circ}\) ka point \((0, -1)\) hai aur cosine x-coordinate hota hai.

Tasdeeq
Kyun: 90 second teen chauthai (3/4) chakkar hai: rider choti (60 s) se guzar kar neeche aate hue centre ki seedh mein hai, aur centre 28 ft par hai. Hisaab aur tasveer dono ek hi baat kehte hain. Chakkar ko chaar hisson mein sochein: 0 s neeche, 30 s centre ki seedh mein upar jate hue, 60 s choti, 90 s centre ki seedh mein neeche aate hue, 120 s phir neeche.

blocks.prompt: 7 (c) [not labelled in print] A carnival ride consists of a vertical wheel with a diameter of 40 feet. The centre of the wheel is 28 feet above the ground. The wheel rotates at a constant speed and takes 120 seconds to make one complete revolution. At what times will the rider be 36 feet above the ground?
blocks.explanation:
\(h(t) = 36\) hal karna hai; ek chakkar mein do jawab hain (upar jate hue aur neeche aate hue).
Plan: cosine akela karna, \([0, 2\pi)\) mein dono angles, phir waqt.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(h(t) = 28 - 20\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{60}t\right)\), \(h = 36\).
Humein find karna hai: woh saare \(t\) jin par \(h(t) = 36\).
Tareeqa: Cosine ko akela karenge; cosine Quadrant II aur III mein negative hota hai, is liye har chakkar mein do angles milenge.

Cosine akela karein
\[28 - 20\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{60}t\right) = 36\]
\[-20\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{60}t\right) = 8\]
\[\cos\left(\tfrac{\pi}{60}t\right) = -0.4\]
Kyun: Dono taraf se 28 minus kiya, phir \(-20\) se divide kiya: \(8 \div (-20) = -0.4\).

Ek chakkar mein dono angles
\[\cos^{-1}(0.4) = 66.42^{\circ}\]
\[\tfrac{\pi}{60}t = 113.58^{\circ} \text{ or } 246.42^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Pehle reference angle nikala (sign chhor kar): \(66.42^{\circ}\). Cosine negative hai, to angle Quadrant II (\(180^{\circ} - 66.42^{\circ}\)) ya Quadrant III (\(180^{\circ} + 66.42^{\circ}\)) mein hoga.
Dhyan dein: Sirf calculator ka ek jawab likh dena aur doosra bhool jana aam ghalti hai; sawal "times" (jama) poochta hai.

Waqt mein badlein
\[\tfrac{\pi}{60}t = 3t \text{ degrees}\]
\[t_1 = \tfrac{113.58}{3} \approx 37.86 \text{ s}\]
\[t_2 = \tfrac{246.42}{3} \approx 82.14 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{60}\) radian \(= \frac{180^{\circ}}{60} = 3^{\circ}\), is liye angle degrees mein \(3t\) hai. Dono angles ko 3 se divide kiya. Yani pahiya har second mein \(3^{\circ}\) ghoomta hai; \(360^{\circ}\) ke liye 120 second, jo sawal mein diya hai.

Tasdeeq
\[t_1 + t_2 = 120 \;\checkmark\]
\[28 - 20\cos(113.58^{\circ}) = 28 + 8 = 36 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono waqt choti (60 s) ke dono taraf barabar faasle par hain, jaise hona chahiye. Key ke 37.87 s aur 82.13 s angle ko \(113.6^{\circ}\) round karne se aaye hain; ek decimal tak jawab wohi hai. Har 120 second baad yeh dobara hota hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(t \approx 37.86\) s aur \(t \approx 82.14\) s (phir har 120 s baad)
